$comment: Builds plugins/specgate from the user guides. See CONTRIBUTING.md#agent-plugin.
name: specgate
description: Use SpecGate to check that two implementations of a component behave the same: install the CLI, annotate Rust or C# APIs, capture reference behavior from existing tests, replay it against a Rust port, and compare the traces.

skills.name: specgate
skills.title: SpecGate quick path
skills.description: Plans and runs a SpecGate conformance check on the user's codebase: choose the API boundary, reuse existing tests, then discover, capture, validate, replay, and compare. Use when the user asks to add SpecGate, check that a Rust port matches a C# or Rust original, prove two implementations are equivalent, or asks which SpecGate step comes next.

skills.name: specgate-install
skills.title: Install SpecGate
skills.description: Installs the specgate CLI, the C# discovery and weaver tools, the Rust specgate crate, and the SpecGate.Annotations NuGet package. Use when specgate is not on PATH, when cargo install specgate-cli or dotnet add package SpecGate.Annotations is needed, or when SPECGATE_DISCOVERY_PATH or SPECGATE_WEAVER_PATH errors appear.

skills.name: specgate-instrument-rust
skills.title: Instrument Rust with SpecGate
skills.description: Annotates an existing Rust crate for SpecGate capture with spec_component!, #[spec_operation], #[spec_setup], and #[derive(SpecEvent)], including async fn operations. Use when adding SpecGate annotations to Rust code, writing a Rust port that must match a reference, or fixing Rust annotation compile errors.

skills.name: specgate-instrument-csharp
skills.title: Instrument C# with SpecGate
skills.description: Annotates an existing C# assembly for SpecGate capture with [SpecOperation], [SpecSetup], [SpecInput], [SpecEvent], and [SpecException], including Task and ValueTask operations. Use when adding SpecGate attributes to C# code, choosing which C# tests become scenarios, or fixing C# discovery or weave errors.

skills.name: specgate-capture
skills.title: Bind and capture with SpecGate
skills.description: Writes a specgate.yaml binding and runs specgate discover and specgate capture to record reference behavior from the user's existing Rust or C# tests into a CTSC bundle. Use when declaring components in specgate.yaml, recording a reference, or reading capture output.

skills.name: specgate-replay
skills.title: Replay and port with SpecGate
skills.description: Replays a captured SpecGate bundle against a Rust candidate implementation and walks through porting a component from C# or Rust to Rust. Use when running specgate replay, checking that a Rust port matches the original, or when replay reports an unsupported operation or input.

skills.name: specgate-validate-compare
skills.title: Validate and compare SpecGate traces
skills.description: Validates SpecGate registries, traces, and bundles, and compares a candidate trace with the reference trace under ctsc.strict. Use when running specgate validate or specgate compare, or when explaining why compare reports equivalent: false.

skills.name: specgate-troubleshoot
skills.title: Troubleshoot SpecGate
skills.description: Diagnoses failing specgate discover, capture, replay, validate, and compare commands from their error messages and exit codes. Use when a specgate command exits non-zero, reports a capture diagnostic or fault, or a C# weave or build step fails.
